name: Mad Arrow
summary:
Mad Arrow is a defense game where you lead an army to protect your treasure from waves of enemies. Place archers and other units strategically on towers, stairs and other buildings. to stop the invaders. Collect gold from defeated enemies to upgrade your troops and defenses.

In Mad Arrow it's your objective to protect your gold and not get robbed for as long as possible. Fighters will storm your tower and you have to kill them in order to gain more money and place even more fighters on your tower, to defend your base. Decide whether you want soldiers with a bow or a sword and put them wherever you think they work best.
